items.question: What is Upanga: The Soul Blade?
items.answer: Upanga: The Soul Blade is a tactical, turn-based fantasy RPG set in Bomende, a land whose kingdoms have been divided by the return of an ancient power.

items.question: Who do I play as?
items.answer: You command four heroes: Osa the Warrior, Aziza the Scout, Nganga the Shaman, and Kishi the Shapeshifter. Each hero brings a different way to approach an isometric battle.

items.question: What stage of development is Upanga in?
items.answer: Upanga is in active development. Core systems such as movement, turn order, combat, UI, and save/load are being built and tested while the story and cinematic scenes continue to take shape.

items.question: Will Upanga be free?
items.answer: The current plan is for the game to be free to download, with the first part available to play and additional Chapter 1 content available for a small price.

items.question: What kind of combat does Upanga use?
items.answer: Upanga uses initiative-based, tactical turn-based combat on an isometric grid. Players command heroes, move across tiles, spend action points, and choose when to attack, defend, heal, or reposition.

items.question: Is Upanga online or offline?
items.answer: Upanga is planned as a single-player game. Online features are not required for the core experience.

items.question: What is the Soul Blade?
items.answer: The Soul Blade was forged by the kingdoms of Bomende as a symbol of their shared alliance. It shattered while imprisoning Bida, and its four pieces are now guarded across the Crypt, Swamp, Kwae, and Pyramid.

items.question: What platforms are planned?
items.answer: The current release plan includes Android, Apple devices, and Steam.

items.question: Will there be a playtest?
items.answer: A playtest may be offered later when the game reaches a more stable alpha or beta stage. Follow the project on social media for announcements.

items.question: How can I get updates?
items.answer: Follow @upangadev on X for development notes, captures, and release news.

items.question: How can I contact the developer?
items.answer: You can contact the Upanga team at upangadev@zohomail.com.
